about: Event descriptions (Kevin: one pass after the last wave; this is the PILOT of 18, 2026-11-21). Each says only what the cited sentences say; 'basis' lists [article, a phrase from the sentence]. gen_medieval.py applies them and adds each basis sentence to the event's sources (lead or section opener), refusing any phrase it can't find.

song-founded.descr: The Song dynasty begins its rule of China, which lasts until 1279. In its Northern Song period (960–1127) the capital is Bianjing, now Kaifeng.
basis: the capital was in the northern city of Bianjing

ming-founded.descr: After the collapse of the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty, the Ming dynasty takes power; it rules China until 1644.
basis: following the collapse of the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty

christianisation-of-bulgaria.descr: Under Byzantium's strong cultural influence, Bulgaria adopts Christianity.

proclamation-of-the-empire.descr: The Kingdom of Serbia is proclaimed an empire. Kingship carries on as an institution: the title of king is kept for a co-ruler of the emperor.

battle-of-mohacs.descr: King Louis II dies in the battle. After a brief dynastic dispute, the crowns of Hungary and Croatia pass to the Austrian House of Habsburg, and both realms become part of the Habsburg monarchy.
basis: Croatia in personal union with Hungary

basis: the Treaty of Verdun was signed by his three sons
divided the former kingdom of Francia into three kingdoms

coronation-of-stephen-i.descr: Stephen I is crowned at Esztergom on Christmas Day 1000 (or 1 January 1001), and the Principality of Hungary is succeeded by the Christian Kingdom of Hungary.
basis: coronation of St Stephen I at Esztergom

battle-of-grunwald.descr: After this battle and the Battle of Wilkomierz (1435), the State of the Teutonic Order falls into decline.
basis: Following the battles of Grunwald in 1410

sicilian-vespers.descr: A revolt on the island of Sicily throws off the brief Angevin rule of Charles of Anjou.

conquest-of-granada.descr: Muhammad XI, the last Nasrid ruler, formally surrenders Granada in January, ending independent Muslim rule in the Iberian Peninsula.

hundred-years-war.descr: A series of conflicts in which the kings of England lay claim to the French throne.

treaty-of-meerssen.descr: The Treaty of Meerssen adds the western part of Lotharingia to West Francia.

kingdom-of-lithuania-mindaugas.descr: Mindaugas is baptised, and Pope Innocent IV issues a bull proclaiming the Kingdom of Lithuania.
